name: @exattime/awe-control-plane
description: The AWE execution control plane: versioned workflow manifests, the Workflow Registry, the deterministic policy and approval engines, the append-only run journal with its state projection, the controlled tool-invocation boundary, and the step engine that gives a run retry, timeout, cancellation, pause/resume and compensation. Pure and provider-neutral; depends only on @exattime/awe-kernel.
